name: Josep Tarradellas Barcelona-El Prat Airport

runway.v: three runways; the longest, 06L/24R, is 3,352 m long and 60 m wide

slots.v: in summer, general aviation slots (arrival and departure) are coordinated no more than 30 days ahead
slots.quote: During the summer season, general aviation slots (arrival + departure) will not be coordinated more than 30 days in advance.

max_aircraft.v: from June to September, aircraft of 15,000 kg MTOW or less cannot arrive between 07:00 and 11:30
max_aircraft.quote: they cannot operate arrivals within the time period 0700-1130

handling.v: the AIP lists AVIAVIP FBO, United Aviation FBO, ExecuJet Spain, General Aviation Service, Jetex Executive Aviation Barcelona, Skyvalet and Universal Aviation Spain as general aviation agents and FBO managers
handling.quote: General Aviation agents and General and Business Aviation terminal Managers (FBO):

noise.v: a special night runway configuration is used between 23:00 and 07:00 local
noise.quote: Night time configuration between 2300 and 0700 LT:

missing: curfew (night noise restrictions are in AD 2-LEBL item 21 sections 5, 6 and 8, which the fetched page text did not contain)
ppr (no PPR stated in the parts read; slot rules recorded instead)
notes: Night-time noise operating restrictions are in AD 2-LEBL item 21.1 sections 5 and 6, which the HTML page as read did not contain (the 15,000 kg 07:00-11:30 rule time basis not stated; excludes ambulance, emergency, State and some public service flights). The night runway configuration is not a curfew. Ramp-0 is for corporate and private aircraft only. Header shows WEF 01-OCT-26 and WEF 03-SEP-26. | 2026-10-31 run: re-read the ENAIRE HTML page (header WEF 01-OCT-26 / 03-SEP-26) in two parts; item 21 (noise abatement) was not in the converted text, only cross-references to it (night use of RWY 24R/06L in item 21 para 5; noise operating restrictions in item 21 section 8). No PPR wording found; non-regular GA operators must request arrival and associated departure slots, stay limited to 96 hours. The ENAIRE PDF at aip.enaire.es/aip/contenido_AIP/AD/AD2/LEBL/LE_AD_2_LEBL_en.pdf returned pages dated 2023-2024 (older than the HTML) and was not used. Owner may download the full current AD 2-LEBL PDF from ENAIRE to read item 21. | 2026-11-02 run: re-read ENAIRE AD 2 LEBL PDF (WEF 01-OCT-26) in full (about 92,000 characters); it ends at AD 2-LEBL 13 and item 21 (noise abatement) is not in the converted text, so curfew stays missing. Amendment page LE_Amdt_A_2026_08_AD_2_LEBL_es.html could not be opened. The PDF's AD 2-LEBL 9 page (stamped WEF 11-JUL-24) gives the 15,000 kg arrival restriction as June-August, 0700-0959; the HTML AD 2 page (headers WEF 01-OCT-26 and 03-SEP-26), re-read today, gives June-September, 0700-1130. The recorded rule follows the HTML page, which is the more recent; time basis not stated. The HTML page's second part (from character 100,000) was also read and has no item 21 either. | 2026-11-04 run: Spanish HTML AD 2 page again only cross-refers to item 21 ('ver AD 2-LEBL apartado 21.1, puntos 5 y 6'), so curfew stays missing. Ministry noise action plan Phase IV (Nov 2024, https://cdn.transportes.gob.es/portal-web-transportes/aereo/politicas-aeroportuarias/medioambiente/par/catalunya/par-iv-barcelona-definitivo.pdf) says 'El aeropuerto tiene un horario H24 por lo que hay operativa en periodo nocturno', and gives a night noise charge uplift 23:00-06:59 LT (+140% category 1, +40% category 2); no outright no-curfew statement and its section 8.3.4 was not reached. AIP SUP A 142/26 (3 Sep 2026 to about 3 Sep 2027, RET A1 works) has phased night closures 2300-0700 LT, including RWY 02/20 and 06L/24R in Phase 0.
